recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic red-saturated group portrait featuring four figures standing against a flat wall, anchored by a large, glowing neon sign above their heads that provides the primary light source and atmospheric haze.
coreVisualRelationships: The neon sign acts as the primary light source, casting deep shadows downward.
Monochromatic red palette unifying the subjects, background, and typography.
Symmetrical group arrangement with the tallest element (neon) at the top center.
High contrast between the glowing light tubes and the dark silhouettes of the clothing.
coreInvariants: Visible neon tube hardware (wires, transformers, glass supports)
Hard shadows cast directly beneath the light source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four human figures at 1:1 scale relative to each other, positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large horizontal neon sign in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing neon text, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and follows their vertical silhouettes to the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the red wall acts as a dense, textured backdrop that feels compressed by the color saturation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation with low value in shadows; the highlights are blown out to white-red in the center of the neon tubes.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals representing the ends of glass tubes
Double-line or single-line stroke to mimic gas-filled lighting
Visible black wire connectors between letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Open loops in letters like P and R to show tube bending
Disconnected crossbars where glass must break

treatment.shadow: Soft red drop shadow on wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A physical, glowing neon display font paired with a clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the physical glass bending of the primary display text
Clean geometric structure for the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four people (two men, two women) standing in a line against a flat wall. The entire scene is bathed in intense monochromatic red light coming from above. The subjects wear dark, simple clothing. High contrast, moody atmosphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large neon sign at the top center with custom-drawn glass tube lettering. Include black wires and hardware. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a clean, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the entire image monochromatic red?
Does the neon text have a visible glow and bloom effect?
Are the shadows cast downward from the light source?
Is the secondary text widely tracked?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
Complexity of the neon tube wiring
Tracking width of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the neon sign
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light falloff on the subjects' shoulders.
Ensure the neon tubes have visible mounting hardware.
Verify the red color doesn't lose all detail in the shadows.
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the physical space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Red + Top-Down Neon Light + Centered Group Portrait + Wide-Tracked Geometric Type
